matrix.expectedBehavior: Fallback to in-memory sliding token bucket, preventing unconstrained traffic
matrix.actualBehavior: Fallback in-memory token bucket actively enforced limits; 21st request blocked
matrix.recoveryBehavior: Automatic transition back to Redis atomic Lua token bucket upon reconnect

matrix.expectedBehavior: System health reports degraded, API remains functional
matrix.actualBehavior: Dependency health returned degraded, postgres and API remained up
matrix.recoveryBehavior: Redis ping succeeds on next check, health returns to healthy

matrix.failureScenario: Database query timeout / connection pool exhaustion

matrix.actualBehavior: DB error safely handled, status reported as degraded without unhandled rejection
matrix.recoveryBehavior: Connection restored upon next successful query execution
